description: A shell script for testing git operations with submodules, including rebasing, stashing, and interactive rebase scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to simulate time passing.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the output of a command or file contents.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command that must fail for the test to pass.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
